 Item
 5.02. Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory
Arrangements of Certain Officers. 
 On November 23, 2026, The Coca-Cola Company (the “Company”)
announced that David V. Elkins will succeed John Murphy as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, effective April 2, 2027.
Mr. Murphy will continue to serve as President of the Company. Mr. Murphy intends to retire at a later date in 2027.
 Mr. Elkins, age 58, has served as Executive Vice President
and Chief Financial Officer of Bristol Myers Squibb Company (“BMS”) since 2019. He joined BMS in connection with its acquisition
of Celgene Corporation, where he served as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer. Before joining Celgene Corporation, Mr.
Elkins held senior finance positions at Johnson & Johnson. His prior experience also includes roles at Becton, Dickinson and Company
and AstraZeneca PLC. He began his career in finance at The Boeing Company.
 In connection with Mr. Elkins’ appointment, the
Company provided Mr. Elkins a letter setting forth the primary compensation elements that will be effective upon the commencement of his
employment and the Company and Mr. Elkins separately entered into a deferred cash agreement providing for the replacement of certain compensation
he will forfeit from BMS.
 Pursuant to Mr. Elkins’ letter, his base salary
